name: oot_enemy_torch_slug
author: Skijer
description: Ocarina of Time's Torch Slug in Majora's Mask: it crawls along walls, lunges at you and burns you with its flame. A first blow puts the fire out, a Goron pound flips it over and ice freezes it. Custom enemy oot.torch_slug and its soul soul.oot.torch_slug. Uses OoT Asset Loader resources.
